items: 修正英文商店历史元数据，运行行为保持不变。
新增中英文商店元数据与配置输入本地化键，完善多语言展示。
适配 NexusPipeline v0.14.4：多实例 reuse 编辑隔离 config 下全部实例目录，保存、取消和恢复后还原原始现场。
新增 one_dragon.yml 编辑准备脚本，仅保留选中实例并同步 active、active_in_od，附加配置纳入编辑事务。
兼容 OneDragon 实际生成的同级 YAML 列表与数字型 idx，修复单实例和多实例复用编辑失败。

en-US.description: Manage Zenless Zone Zero OneDragon script instances, configuration paths, logs, and bound user settings.

items: Corrected the English store history metadata; runtime behavior is unchanged.
Added English store metadata and localized configuration-input labels and descriptions.
Adapted to NexusPipeline v0.14.4: during reuse editing, isolated every instance directory under config, then restored the original state after saving, cancelling, or recovering.
Added an edit-preparation script for one_dragon.yml that keeps only the selected instance, synchronizes active and active_in_od, and includes additional configuration files in the edit transaction.
Added compatibility for the same-level YAML list and numeric idx values generated by OneDragon, fixing single-instance and multi-instance reuse editing.
